collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager's leg falls asleep during a long evening story: walk it off, or sit back down and wait.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been sitting cross-legged on the ground through a long evening story, and when everyone gets up to go home, (subject.he/she) discovers that (subject.his/her) left leg has gone completely to sleep. (subject.He/she) stands up. The leg does not.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) sets off on a leg that feels as if it belongs to someone else, with a long, careful, wobbly walk, like a seabird on a windy day. Halfway home (subject.he/she) realizes that three children are walking behind (subject.him/her), doing exactly the same walk. By the time the leg wakes up, (subject.he/she) is leading a parade.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) sits back down with great dignity and says that (subject.he/she) would like to stay and enjoy the stars a while. (friend) sits down beside (subject.him/her). "Leg asleep?" "Completely." They look up at the stars, which really are very good tonight, until the pins and needles fade.
